text: A simple illustration of a dynamic digital picture of the cabinet of the future. Shooting from a high angle. the interior of the room is made of high-tech materials of the future, the lighting of the fixtures built into the ceiling is dimmed and scattered over the surfaces. Close-up of a 25-year-old man with short blond hair looking up, his face etched with undisguised terror, his mouth wide open and twisted in fear. His figure is of medium build, he is dressed in a beautiful black shirt, the collar of his shirt is unbuttoned, he is sitting at a table leaning back against the back of a leather armchair. With both hands, he seemed to be shielding himself from an unknown danger. He has a face with a well-defined chin, piercing black eyes distorted by horror.Background: an office wall covered with futuristic material. The atmosphere is harsh, gloomy, noir-style, with voluminous lighting and picturesque concept art with rich textures.
